label: Linked Select
description: Pick a parent entry, then a related child entry (cascading dropdowns).
options.parentContentType.description: The content type shown in the first (parent) dropdown.
options.childContentType.description: Content types already listed as relations on the selected parent.
options.childContentType.selectParentFir: Select a parent content type first…
options.childContentType.noRelations: No relation targets found on the parent…
options.childContentType.noRelationsHint: Add a relation on the parent content type that targets the child, then try again.
options.relationField.description: The relation field on the child pointing to the parent. Auto-detected when left empty.
options.labelField.description: Field used as the option label (e.g. name, title). Auto-detected when left empty.
input.misconfigured: Set both a parent and a child content type in the field settings.
